lines:
  - id: eic.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero amount"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    note: "Constant zero, used for amounts that are outside the tool's scope or for the credit when it can't be taken. The parameter ss.zero has the value 0."

  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1]
    note: "Step 5 question 1 covers clergy and church employees, whose line 1 is adjusted (see Clergy and Church employees). The tool does not compute these cases. scope.schedule1, which covers minister and church employee income, refuses them. The tool computes only the plain line 1z case."

  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.h_zero}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, scope.other_income]
    note: "Medicaid waiver payments and the Schedule 1 line 8s exclusion are outside scope. scope.other_income and scope.schedule1 refuse them, so the computed case is zero."

  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}

  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.h_zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    note: "The tool supports no nontaxable combat pay; filers who have it are refused through s8812.combat_pay. The computed case is zero."

  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  - id: eic.h_sc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of Schedules C on the return"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.sc_count}

  - id: eic.h_uses_wsb
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: Were you self-employed at any time in 2025 (Worksheet B)?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_sc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Self-employment is read as having any Schedule C. Statutory employees, clergy and church employees are refused elsewhere (scope.schedule1)."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_se
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B lines 1e and 2c (self-employment earned income, you and spouse combined)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.eic_se}
    note: "The per-person field person.eic_se is read as each person's Worksheet B Part 1 line 1e (Schedule SE filers) or Part 2 line 2c (Schedule C net profit). The catalog does not define this field; this is the chosen reading. Part 3 (statutory employees) is out of scope and is refused by scope.schedule1."

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_wsb_se, eic.earned_income]}
    shown_when: eic.h_uses_wsb

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_uses_wsb
    note: "Line 6 is reached only when line 4b is more than zero; if line 4b is zero or less the worksheet STOPs. The zero floor keeps the declared type and changes no reachable value."

  - id: eic.h_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing a joint return"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}

  - id: eic.h_qc_ssn
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: dependent, field: dependent.one, where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn_child, {const: true}]}}
    note: "dependent.eic_ssn_child is read as an EIC qualifying child with a valid SSN."

  - id: eic.h_qc_any
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: dependent, field: dependent.one, where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}}

  - id: eic.h_has_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 1: at least one qualifying child"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_any, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

  - id: eic.h_mar_sep
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_lim0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, no children, other filers ($19,104)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, no children, married filing jointly ($26,214)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, 1 child, other filers ($50,434)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, 1 child, married filing jointly ($57,554)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim2o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, 2 children, other filers ($57,310)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim2j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, 2 children, married filing jointly ($64,430)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim3o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, 3 or more children, other filers ($61,555)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim3j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Limit, 3 or more children, married filing jointly ($68,675)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.joint}

  - id: eic.h_lim
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit for the number of qualifying children with valid SSNs and filing status (Step 1 Q1, Step 5 Q3, Worksheet B line 5)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim0o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim0j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim1o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim1j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim2o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim2j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim3o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim3j

  - id: eic.h_agi_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 1: is the amount on Form 1040, line 11b, less than the limit?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_lim]}

  - id: eic.h_7a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040, line 7a (if a loss, enter -0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: {const: 0}}

  - id: eic.h_inv
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 1: Investment income (lines 2a + 2b + 3b + 7a)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_7a]}

  - id: eic.h_inv_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 2: investment income not more than $11,950"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, le: [eic.h_inv, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}
    note: "Investment income over the limit is a STOP unless Form 4797 is filed. Form 4797 is out of scope and is refused by scope.schedule1 on eic.eligible."

  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of people on the return born after December 31, 1960, and before January 2, 2001"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [person.born_before_2001, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [person.born_after_1960, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_age_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, at least age 25 but under age 65"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

  - id: eic.h_died_noqc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: spouse died in 2025 or return for a decedent (see Pub. 596)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.died_2025, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_qc_path
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, questions 2 to 6 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mar_sep, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_noqc_path
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 (filers without a qualifying child) passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mar_sep, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "For Step 4 question 6 (can you be claimed as a dependent on someone else's return), the closest catalog question is sa.dependent. That question also covers dual-status aliens, who are refused anyway through scope.other_income."

  - id: eic.h_path_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_path, {const: true}]}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_noqc_path, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_reach2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 and 2 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_reach5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 to 4 passed (Step 5 reached)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_path_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_earned_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 3 (Worksheet A) or Worksheet B lines 4b and 5 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_lim]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_lim]}

  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.earned_income
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.wsb_6
    note: "Worksheet B lines 6 to 11 repeat Worksheet A lines 1 to 6, using line 6 (total earned income) instead of Step 5 earned income. The slice lists no lines 7 to 11, so lines 1 to 6 here serve both worksheets: line 1 is Step 5 earned income for Worksheet A filers and Worksheet B line 6 for Worksheet B filers."

  - id: eic.h_l1_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 1 is within the EIC Table"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_lim]}
    note: "The table starts at $1. Amounts below $1 give no credit (line 2 is zero). Amounts at or over the limit are already a STOP."

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars

  - id: eic.h_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_ok, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t3

  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}

  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}

  - id: eic.h_th0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, no children, other filers ($10,620)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.other}
  - id: eic.h_th0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, no children, married filing jointly ($17,730)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_th1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, 1 or more children, other filers ($23,350)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.other}
  - id: eic.h_th1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, 1 or more children, married filing jointly ($30,470)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}

  - id: eic.h_thresh
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold for the number of qualifying children with valid SSNs and filing status"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th0o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th0j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th1o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th1j

  - id: eic.h_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 4 is No and line 3 is not less than the line 5 threshold (line 5 completed)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_thresh]}

  - id: eic.h_l3_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 3 is within the EIC Table"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_lim]}

  - id: eic.h_a0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "No. Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_ok, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a3
    shown_when: eic.h_show5
    note: "Line 5 is blank when line 4 is Yes or line 3 is under the threshold. It is computed either way. Where line 3 is at or over the limit, Step 1 already STOPs, so the amount is zero there."

  - id: eic.h_min52
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Smaller of lines 5 and 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_show5, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_min52
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_show5, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.line2

  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can take the earned income credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_earned_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
    refuses: [scope.other_income, scope.schedule1, scope.other_line16, s1.line8_other, eic.h_died_noqc]
    note: "These cases are out of scope and refused. Nonresident aliens (Step 1 Q4) and passive activity income (Step 2 Q4): scope.other_income. Form 2555 (Step 1 Q3): s1.line8_other. Form 4797, Schedule E, rental of personal property, clergy, church employees and statutory employees: scope.schedule1. Form 8814: scope.other_line16. A spouse who died in 2025 or a decedent's return for a filer without a qualifying child (Step 4 Q2, see Pub. 596): eic.h_died_noqc. Every STOP in Steps 1 to 5 and on the worksheet (line 2 or line 7 zero) makes this false. 'Credit figured by the IRS' is not modelled."

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit (Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.line6
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach2, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mar_sep, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach2, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mar_sep, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach2, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mar_sep, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_lim]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, le: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
                - {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_lim]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
    note: "True where a STOP that is actually reached tells you to check the box on line 27c. Those STOPs are Step 1 Q2 (SSN), Step 3 Q6, Step 4 Q3 and Q5, Worksheet A line 2 zero, and Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, line 5 No, or line 7 zero. The nonresident-alien STOP is refused (scope.other_income). The line 27c instructions also allow checking the box when you do not want to claim the credit. No input in the closed interface asks this, so that choice is not modelled."

  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section for the special rule for separated spouses"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mar_sep, {const: true}]}
    note: "Step 3 Q6 'No' and the Special rule for separated spouses apply this box to a married filer who is not filing jointly (MFS, or HOH while married), who has a qualifying child and who passed Q4 and Q5 (lived apart or legally separated). The chosen reading: the box is shown when Step 3 is passed (Step 5 reached) on that path, whatever the later worksheet result."
```

Those STOPs are Step 1 Q2 (SSN), Step 3 Q6, Step 4 Q3 and Q5, Worksheet A line 2 zero, and Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, line 5 No, or line 7 zero. The nonresident-alien STOP is refused (scope.other_income). The line 27c instructions also allow checking the box when you do not want to claim the credit. No input in the closed interface asks this, so that choice is not modelled.
